_schema.note: Official federal-health procurement forecast items only, pulled 2026-09-10 from each agency's own published forecast: CMS (cms.gov Forecast of Opportunities, 1 Sep 2026 workbook, all rows); VA and GSA (the governmentwide Forecast of Contracting Opportunities tool on acquisitiongateway.gov, filtered to the agency's own published rows); IHS, FDA, NIH and HHS-OS (HHS OSDBU SBCX opportunity forecast export, filtered to health-IT relevant rows); DHA (FY2025 Long Range Acquisition Forecast workbook, still the current file on dha.mil, rows carried forward). Trade press, aggregators and SAM.gov notices are excluded. Dollar bands are the agency's own value ranges. Date precision follows the source: CMS, VA and GSA publish day-level solicitation dates; the FCO tool publishes award as a fiscal quarter (carried in the award field as TBD + quarter); SBCX publishes month and year only, so SBCX rows carry the first of the published month. CDC, ONC and ARPA-H have no forward health-IT rows in their current official forecasts (see the September 2026 read). No POC names, emails or phone numbers are carried from any source.

sources.label: CMS Contract Opportunities page (links the current forecast workbook)

HHS OSDBU SBCX Opportunity Forecast (CMS, IHS, FDA, NIH, CDC, HHS-OS rows)
DHA FY2025 Long Range Acquisition Forecast (XLSX, modified 2025-05-22; still the posted file)
VA Forecast of Contracting Opportunities (VA vendor portal, interactive query; version 26.3, reviewed 05/07/2026)
ARPA-H Open Funding Opportunities (no traditional forecast; checked, no health-IT solicitation open)

checked_no_rows.note: 562 CDC rows in the HHS OSDBU SBCX export, every one carrying an FY24 or FY25 award date with no solicitation date, and zero rows in an IT NAICS. cdc.gov/contracts has no forecast page of its own. CDC's forecast has not refreshed, so CDC has no forward health-IT rows.

ONC buys through the Program Support Center under ASA. The PSC rows are all FY24 and FY25 dates, and the only 2026 entries under ASA are ACF and refugee-program buys. No ONC line exists anywhere in the export.

No rows in SBCX and no traditional forecast. The May research-funding URL now 404s; open solicitations live under Explore Funding, and none of what is open in September is a health-IT buy. DIGIHEALS, UPGRADE and the Biomedical Data Fabric Toolbox sit in the portfolio without an open solicitation.
